text:
This build brings fixes for video messages, editing, lists and playback. Please try:

- Send a video message, leave the chat and come back. Upload progress should keep up without freezing the app.
- Add music to a video and play the full editor preview. The music should keep playing.
- Pause a video while it loads on a slow connection. Its position should stay steady.
- Edit a list offline, then reconnect and check that your changes survive.
- Browse your feeds and check whether videos you have already watched keep coming back.

You can now import FLAC audio too. If something goes sideways, use Report a Bug in Settings and tell us what happened.
